preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The value of k is between 1 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 400 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for x, y, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (x, y, w) has vertices x and y between 1 and n inclusive, x is not equal to y, and weight w is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sorted(d[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))[k - 1]
postconditions.description: The output is the k-th smallest shortest path length in the sorted list of all shortest path lengths between distinct pairs of vertices.
